source_name: KRPP Raportet Vjetore — annual public procurement activity reports (Albanian series)
why_relevant: KRPP is obliged by the Law on Public Procurement to collect, analyse and publish procurement statistics, and does so as a long-running annual PDF series (individual years located for 2013, 2020 and 2023, implying a continuous run). These reports carry the aggregate tables the raw notice feed does not: totals by procedure type, by contract type, by contracting authority, framework-agreement counts and values, and year-on-year comparisons. They are the authoritative denominator for any market-sizing of Kosovo public spend on banking/payments equipment and services, and they survive long after individual notices are removed.

source_name: KRPP Annual Reports — English edition series (/eng/)
why_relevant: KRPP publishes an English parallel of the annual report, which removes translation ambiguity when extracting statistical tables and makes the series usable for cross-country Western Balkans benchmarking. The 2022 edition is the one carrying the widely cited headline figure of 10,290 contracts worth EUR 559 million. A fetch of the 2022 English PDF returned a 2.2 MB PDF payload, so the /eng/ path is populated, though the binary was not text-parsed in this pass.

source_name: arkivaOSHP — Procurement Review Body legacy archive site
source_subtype: legacy/archive mirror of a quasi-judicial review body
why_relevant: A textbook instance of exactly what this cell exists to find: when OSHP (Organi Shqyrtues i Prokurimit, the Procurement Review Body) migrated to a new platform, it explicitly moved the documents from the old website to a separate archive domain rather than deleting them. Review-body decisions are the richest indirect record of contested awards — they name the contracting authority, the incumbent, the challengers, the lot values and often the technical specification dispute, and they persist for procedures whose original notices have long since expired off the main portal. For banking/payments this is where you learn who really won a card-personalisation or ATM-servicing lot and why a competitor lost.

source_name: AQP — Agjencia Qendrore e Prokurimit: centralized framework contracts register
why_relevant: This is the framework-agreement register the cell rationale specifically calls for. AQP, the central purchasing body inside the Ministry of Finance (established under Article 94 of Law 04/L-042), publishes its centralized framework contracts with effective dates, and a parallel 'Kontratat Tjera' page for other contracts. Because Kosovo framework contracts run one to a maximum of three years with a plus/minus 30 percent quantity tolerance and terminate automatically once the indicative value plus tolerance is exhausted, the published start date plus the stated duration directly predicts the re-tender window — the single highest-value inference in this whole cell. Centralized lots are also the vehicle through which whole-of-government purchases of equipment classes get bundled.

source_name: Balkan Tender Watch — Kosovo PPRC annual reports mirror
source_subtype: NGO document mirror / comparative report repository
why_relevant: An NGO-run regional repository that independently mirrors Kosovo PPRC annual reports under a stable path (/uploaded/Kosovo ENG/PPRC Reports/), with PPRC 2015 and PPRC 2017 both located. This is genuine archival redundancy: when the Kosovo government reorganises e-prokurimi's document tree the historical report PDFs frequently break, and this mirror preserves the older editions in English. It also hosts Western Balkans comparative procurement reports for 2022, 2023 and 2024 covering Kosovo alongside Serbia, BiH, North Macedonia and Montenegro, giving a regional denominator.

source_name: RKS Open Data portal — KRPP organization datasets (opendata.rks-gov.net)
why_relevant: The Kosovo government's CKAN-style open-data catalogue carries a KRPP organization page with datasets tagged prokurimi elektronik, tenderat and kontratat kornize, including year-stamped XLSX contract extracts (a 2020 file was observed). Because these are versioned dataset resources rather than a live query interface, they function as frozen annual snapshots — exactly the sort of point-in-time record that lets you detect whether the live feed was later edited. The kontratat kornize tag is directly on-target for framework-agreement expiry tracking.

source_name: Municipal procurement document archives on kk.rks-gov.net (per-municipality contract PDF repositories)
why_relevant: Kosovo municipalities run their own WordPress-based procurement sections under kk.rks-gov.net/<municipality>/category/prokurimi/, with distinct sub-categories for signed contracts (kontratat), contract-award notices (B08 Njoftim per dhenje te kontrates), contract-signature notices (B52 Njoftimi per nenshkrimin e kontrates) and even contract-termination decisions (Vendim për ndërprerje të kontratës). These are locally hosted PDFs of the actual signed contracts, and they persist on the municipal site long after the central portal has expired the notice — often the only surviving full-text contract. Termination decisions are a rare and valuable signal for early re-tender.

source_name: Central-institution procurement document folders (ministries, Customs, Health) on rks-gov.net subdomains
source_subtype: contracting-authority document archive with year filters
why_relevant: Central contracting authorities maintain their own year-filterable document indexes for procurement contracts — the Ministry of Health exposes a Documents/Index endpoint with an explicit ?year= parameter, which is a ready-made historical query interface, and Kosovo Customs serves award notices from a sharedfolder/AnnouncementFiles/ path with year-prefixed GUID filenames plus a dedicated OpenData section. For banking and payments, Customs and the tax administration are among the most relevant buyers of payment, scanning and cash-handling technology, and their own archives outlive the central portal listing.

source_name: BIRN Kosovo / KALLXO.com — 'Ndër me Tender' annual procurement monitoring report series
source_subtype: investigative-media monitoring report series and tag archive
why_relevant: BIRN Kosovo publishes a long-running annual public-procurement monitoring report (the 'Ndër me Tender' / 'Tenders of Endearment' series, with a 2015 edition located as a hosted PDF) covering 169 contracting authorities, ranking spend categories and documenting irregularities and cases under investigation. Combined with KALLXO's tag archives for KRPP and for the National Audit Office, this is a durable journalistic archive that narrates procurements whose primary records have since been withdrawn, and often names the specific suppliers and disputed lots.

source_name: Open Data Kosovo — e-Prokurimi project and red-flag dataset work
why_relevant: Open Data Kosovo has worked with municipalities to collect and visualise their procurement data into the e-prokurimi platform and built a red-flag algorithm that automatically detects irregularities in procurement processes. As a pointer this is valuable in two ways: it identifies which municipalities have digitised historical records at all (a coverage map for the archival layer), and any published red-flag dataset or codebook is a reusable scoring methodology for a market-intelligence pipeline.

source_name: Open-Procurements.com — Kosovo country study on open procurement data and competition
why_relevant: A 2024 country study titled around utilising open data as a tool for greater competition, focused on Kosovo. Studies like this are pointer-rich secondary literature for the archival layer: they typically enumerate exactly which datasets exist, which fields are missing, which years are incomplete, and where the official publication practice changed — the metadata about the archive that no portal documents itself.

source_name: D+ (Demokracia Plus) — analysis of the organisation and functioning of the Regulatory Commission for Public Procurement (Serbian edition)
why_relevant: One of the few substantive Serbian-language documents located for this cell. D+ analyses how the RKJN (Regulatorna komisija za javne nabavke, the Serbian-language name for KRPP) is constituted and operates, including member qualification requirements and its control and supervisory functions. This matters archivally because it documents institutional composition at a fixed date, and because it establishes the Serbian terminology set — RKJN, javne nabavke, ugovori, okvirni sporazum — needed to search Serbian-language mirrors and northern-municipality publications.

source_name: AIP legacy archive subsite (aip.rks-gov.net/arkiva) — historical audit and institutional PDFs
why_relevant: A concrete example of a Kosovo government institution keeping an explicit /arkiva/ subtree containing older publications, including a 2017 audit report on financial statements. This is precisely the removed-but-preserved layer this cell targets, and the path structure (/arkiva/assets/cms/uploads/files/Publikime/) is a reusable fingerprint: probing for /arkiva/ across rks-gov.net institutional subdomains is a cheap, high-yield discovery tactic for recovering documents dropped from current site navigation.

source_name: GAP Institute — public procurement research archive (Instituti GAP)
why_relevant: GAP Institute publishes recurring procurement analyses in Albanian and English, including a December 2023 study on public procurement and inclusive economic empowerment and commentary on procurement planning failures at publicly owned enterprises. Their documents cite the PPRC annual-report figures and thereby preserve specific historical statistics in quotable, text-extractable form even where the underlying report PDF later moves — a practical hedge against link rot in the primary statistical series.

source_name: MAPL Doracaku për Menaxhimin e Kontratave Publike (public contract management manual)
why_relevant: The Ministry of Local Government Administration's contract-management handbook documents how contracts are administered after award — amendments, extensions, terminations and record retention obligations at contracting authorities. For an archival cell this is the map of what post-award paperwork should exist and where it is supposed to be kept, which is the basis for targeted access-to-information requests when a contract's execution history is not published.

source_name: Komuna e Prishtinës — Prokurimi / Njoftim për kontratë
why_relevant: Kosovo's largest municipality publishes its own contract notices, including service contracts that cover bank account/current-account services (shërbime bankare, llogari rrjedhëse), salary payment handling and municipal fee collection. Municipal pages often carry the dossier/award PDFs, not just the headline notice.

source_name: kk.rks-gov.net municipal template — /<komuna>/category/prokurimi/ (all 38 municipalities)
why_relevant: Confirmed that Kosovo municipalities share a common CMS path pattern under kk.rks-gov.net (observed for Skenderaj and Prishtinë). This is the highest-leverage pointer in the cell: one URL template enumerates the procurement pages of ~38 contracting authorities, the densest population of low-visibility banking-services tenders.

source_name: Komuna e Gjakovës — own domain (gjakova.rks-gov.net) procurement PDFs
why_relevant: Evidence that some municipalities run their own subdomain outside the kk.rks-gov.net template and host procurement PDFs directly under /wp-content/uploads/, i.e. documents that may never surface in the central portal's HTML. Important because it breaks the assumption that one template covers all municipalities.

source_name: Prishtina Online — komuna procurement mirror (njoftim për kontratë / dhënie e kontratës)
why_relevant: Municipality of Prishtina's e-services portal mirrors both contract notices and award notices. Separate host from kk.rks-gov.net, so it is a resilient fallback when the government CMS is unreachable, and it exposes an explicit award-notice section useful for identifying which bank actually won.

source_name: Ministria e Financave, Punës dhe Transfereve (MFPT) — incl. Thesari
why_relevant: The single most important buyer in this cell: the Treasury (Thesari) owns the government's banking relationships, the KFMIS/public finance management system and the payment/collection rails. Its own site carries procurement notices, budget circulars and Treasury notices that reveal upcoming payment-system procurements before they hit the central portal.

source_name: Administrata Tatimore e Kosovës (ATK) — announcements / tenders
why_relevant: ATK is a core payments buyer: tax collection channels, e-payment integration with banks, and the EDI/e-services stack. Its site publishes 'njoftim' items including at least one sealed-bid procurement notice, showing it posts procurement outside the central portal.

source_name: Dogana e Kosovës — Shpalljet / Tenderët
why_relevant: Kosovo Customs is a high-volume collector of duties and therefore a buyer of collection/e-payment and bank guarantee handling services. Its tender section is deep (pagination observed to at least page 104), giving a long historical series of its own notices — far more history than most central-portal views expose.

source_name: Ministria e Shëndetësisë — Dokumente / Kontratat për prokurim
why_relevant: A rare case of a ministry publishing an indexed, year-filterable library of procurement CONTRACTS (not just notices), with directly downloadable B05 contract-notice PDFs. Contract-level documents give pricing and counterparty detail that award notices omit — the template of what to look for at other authorities.
